features.justification_quote: task abandonment is one of the headline behaviors

features.quote: neutral phrasing ("Stop working on the task… provide a brief reason")
features.justification_quote: The point of the suite is *relative* comparison under a fixed affordance

features.quote: the loop terminate when an agent clearly bails in text without calling `give_up`
features.justification_quote: We don't want those to burn all `max_turns` and pollute the persistence metric
bounds cost and defines "exhausted all options,"

features.quote: A second consecutive empty turn effectively ends the episode via the turn budget
features.justification_quote: avoid infinite spinning while still giving the agent a chance to resume

features.quote: All file paths resolve under the workspace root; `..` and absolute paths are rejected
features.justification_quote: a distressed/misbehaving agent must not be able to touch the host filesystem
prevent hangs and runaway output; keep transcripts (and judge token costs) bounded
